params.name: Fields
params.description:
Optional parameter to filter the top-level fields that are returned. 
The list must be in CSV format. Example: field1,field2,field3

items.docs:
The excel sheet name field is required for excel files and the delimiter field, which defaults to a comma if not set, is required for non-excel files.
The row limit is 150,000 for excel files and 2 million for csv files.
To avoid request timeouts on large files, set validateFile to false to skip validation on upload; the file will then be validated when a projection is run.
